prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one transparent pixel-art dialogue head portrait for a gritty medieval RPG. Substantively REDRAW the character, not crop the old full-body image.
Input reference 1 is IDENTITY ONLY; references 2–5 are Mara, Iwo, Leiya and Tore, STYLE/COMPOSITION ONLY. Match their large adult head, short neck, narrow minimal collar, angular cheek and nose planes, dark tiny eyes, coherent coarse pixel clusters. Do not borrow their facial identity, hair or clothes.
Subject: Hepo, HIG-S01-NPC, a man in his forties who maintains mountain paths. Preserve the FIRST reference's individual identity: messy windblown medium-brown hair with full outer silhouette and chunky side locks, broad cheeks, round substantial nose, thick expressive uneven brows, a short full brown beard and moustache. Apply the latest card's visibly rough ruddy wind-weathered skin and forties age with broad cheek shadows and a few clear brow/under-eye age planes, without making him elderly. He is concerned but kind and steady, still welcoming travellers and interested in their faraway stories; inner brows slightly raised, eyes thoughtful, mouth gently relaxed rather than heroic scowl or cheerful smile. Preserve moss-green short cape/collar over thick ochre work coat with a narrow dark-brown tie. No new hood, hat, armor or medals. Rope and wooden stop/detour sign are outside this close portrait crop; do not invent a safety certification or repair-completed scene.
Composition: a single head in slight three-quarter view, preserving the source facing direction. Logical target 74 by 100 pixels. Head including all hair approximately y=5 to 83, eyes around y=40, chin around y=82; only a very short neck and narrow clothing wedge at y=84–96. Face is the main subject, not shoulders or chest. Keep genuine empty transparent margins of at least 3 logical pixels above hair and outside BOTH outermost hair/ears and lower collar. Do not cut off ear, hair, or collar tips. Retain source hair mass rather than trimming it to fit. Full silhouette must fit naturally inside the canvas.
Medium: deliberately low-resolution-looking hard-edged pixel clusters designed for 74x100 readability, roughly 24–32 restrained muted colors. Larger connected cheekbone and nose shadow blocks, sparse purposeful wrinkles, limited hair highlight groups. Small dark eyes with at most a dim single-pixel sclera accent, never broad white eyeballs. Strong adult anatomy, slight asymmetry and distinct personality. No smooth gradient, painterly texture, anti-aliased blur, noisy dither, strand-by-strand hair, glossy anime, chibi face, decorative frame or text. Transparent empty background with binary-edge intent; no checkerboard drawing, shadows or ground. Produce only one portrait, no panels or labels.
